source: Pinned independent SameBoy CGB-E; actual local cartridge (SHA1-checked); pret symbols; scene 6 loop entry redirected to the real exit as note 128; movie window PlayIntroScene..PrepareTitleScreen
unit: dots (4 per machine cycle) after the dispatch ends (the vector jp starts); stores at their write effect
